Same AI model, same prompt — one reply is generic AI slop, the other sounds exactly like me, because it is connected to my brain. That brain is just a private GitHub repo of markdown files that holds who you are, how you write and what you believe, and it runs two ways: locally with Claude Code, and online on your own server over MCP so any AI can read it. Free, open source, self hosted — here is how to build yours.
